name: APEX
recent: Apex Equity Holdings 于 2026 年 11 月 16 日完成第二批也是最后一批私募，发行价定为每股 RM0.4616，较 5 日成交量加权平均价折价约 9.95%。公司将于 2026 年 11 月 30 日召开第 36 届年度股东大会。此外，公司涉及一项重大诉讼，且一名董事在 2025 年 9 月增持了股份。
notable: 公司完成第二批私募，发行价定为每股 RM0.4616。
公司将于 2026 年 11 月 30 日召开第 36 届年度股东大会。
集团执行主席 Dato' Seri Farhash Wafa Salvador 于 2025 年 9 月 22 日以每股 RM0.870 增持 2,287,352 股普通股（1.070%）。
risks: 公司进行私募，可能摊薄现有股东权益。
公司涉及一项重大诉讼。
新闻报导 Farhash 取得法庭命令阻止 Bloomberg 文章发布，案件将于 11 月 16 日审理。
earnings: 2026 财年（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 MYR 18,811,000，净利润为 MYR 1,272,000，净利率 6.8%。营收环比增长 15.0%，净利润环比增长 144.6%；营收同比增长 37.4%，但净利润同比下降 77.2%。

recent_en: Apex Equity Holdings fixed the issue price for the second and final tranche of its private placement at RM0.4616 per share on 16 November 2026, a discount of about 9.95% to the 5-day VWAP. It is also involved in a material litigation, and a director acquired shares in September 2025.
notable_en: The company completed the second tranche of its private placement, fixing the issue price at RM0.4616 per share.
Group Executive Chairman Dato' Seri Farhash Wafa Salvador acquired 2,287,352 ordinary shares (1.070%) at RM0.870 per share on 22 September 2025.
risks_en: The company is undertaking a private placement, which may dilute existing shareholders.
The company is involved in a material litigation.
News reports that Farhash obtained a court order to halt a Bloomberg article, with the case to be heard on 16 November.
earnings_en: For the financial year ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 18,811,000 and net income was MYR 1,272,000, with a net margin of 6.8%. Revenue rose 15.0% QoQ and net income rose 144.6% QoQ; revenue grew 37.4% YoY while net income fell 77.2% YoY.
